mapper.select: SELECT a.*, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.permission ORDER BY p.permission SEPARATOR ',') FROM v_account_perms p WHERE p.account_id = a.id) AS perms FROM user_account a WHERE a.id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM user_account WHERE email IS NOT NULL AND email != '' AND email_hash IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_account (username, password_hash, account_type, role, status, display_name, email, email_hash) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, 'user', 'user', 1, #{displayName}, #{email}, #{emailHash})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_account SET password_hash = #{passwordHash} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user_account SET last_login_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user_account SET email = #{email}, email_hash = #{emailHash} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user_account SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user_account SET role = #{role} WHERE id = #{id}
